long_biography.plain_text:
Fahd studied history at King Saud University before taking a diploma at the University of Southern California. He began public service as an undersecretary in the labour and social-affairs ministry, then held senior positions in Saudi sport, including vice-presidencies of the Olympic committee and football federation. Those roles preceded his 1987 appointment to govern Tabuk.

His long tenure in the north-western province has combined government administration with institution-building. He chairs the board of trustees of Fahd Bin Sultan University and the Prince Fahd Bin Sultan Social Program Society, while regional initiatives have supported welfare organisations and public services. He has also led national delegations to the Olympic and Asian Games and retained honorary positions across Saudi sport.
